Periodontal Health Periodontal disease starts small. You might notice some redness or swelling in your gums and they may bleed when you brush. Learn more about our periodontal maintenance services that will improve the health of your mouth and prevent more serious problems, like tooth loss. Periodontal Health Dental Implant Whether you are missing one or more teeth, dental implants may be an option for you. Today's dental implants provide an attractive and comfortable replacement for teeth that are lost to gum disease, cavities, birth defects, trauma or infection. Dental Implant Same Day Smile Dr. Scholes offers a "Same-Day Smile," or All-on-4® Treatment — a popular and successful solid zirconia implant restoration. No worries, join our membership plan! Dental Services in Chandler, AZ Bone Grafting The human body is always changing, and when one or more teeth are missing the jawbone will start to deteriorate. This loss of jawbone can develop and create additional concerns, both with your facial appearance and general health. Read more about Bone Grafting Osseous Surgery Reduction surgery is referred to in the professional world of dentistry as "osseous surgery." Osseous surgery is a surgical procedure performed to reduce the depth of gum pockets. The goal of reduction surgery is to restore the gums to a more natural and healthier state. Read more about Osseous Surgery Gum Grafting Your gums provide your teeth with a natural defense against bacteria and trauma from everyday activities, like chewing, drinking and brushing. When you have recession, the roots of your teeth become exposed and can lead to increased hot and cold sensitivity. Read more about Gum Grafting Guided Bone & Tissue Regeneration Bacteria from periodontal disease can destroy the bone that surrounds and supports your teeth. Often, there is so much destruction that surgery is needed to correct it. Advances in guided bone and tissue regeneration allow Dr. Scholes to rebuild and regenerate some of that bone. Read more about Guided Bone & Tissue Regeneration Cosmetic Periodontal Surgery Cosmetic periodontal surgery can address many concerns with the appearance of your teeth. Soft tissue grafting procedures can be done to cover sensitive, exposed roots, prevent further gum recession, even out your gum line, and help prevent tooth loss. Read more about Cosmetic Periodontal Surgery Oral Cancer Exam Routine oral cancer screenings are an important part of prevention. When caught in the early stages, treatment is more successful. Dr. Scholes will perform a painless examination of your head, neck, and mouth to check for any unusual bumps, sores, or abnormal tissue. Read more about Oral Cancer Exams Tooth Extraction Some damaged decaying teeth are unpleasant and bothersome and will affect your daily activities. So why suffer and be uneasy? Instead of prolonging the pain, visit our office and have it extracted. Read more about Tooth Extraction Frenectomy A simple procedure called a frenectomy will be performed in our comfortable office environment under local anesthetic. The frenum will be removed and when needed, a gingival graft can be placed to correct recession.
